notes: Excerpted from the %SurveyCalibrate macro's %NONE calibration branch (surveycalibrate.sas lines 337-389): the core generalized-least-squares calibration weight formula (CalW = w + w#(X*beta), beta = ginv(X'*wx)*(T-X'*w)) run directly in PROC IML against the repo's own Mortality data and control totals. The macro's CALL SYMPUTX bookkeeping (writing status back to the wrapping %macro) is omitted since this bundle calls the IML math directly; that same construct is the subject of a filed regression test since the hosted engine does not yet support CALL SYMPUTX inside PROC IML.
